name: Nakameguro
tagline: Three minutes to Shibuya, eight to Roppongi — and the highest rent on this site.
summary: The Tokyu Toyoko Line reaches Shibuya in three minutes; the Hibiya Line reaches Roppongi in eight and Toranomon in 15, and originates here so you can get a seat. Independent restaurants and shops line the Meguro River, and few Tokyo neighborhoods feel this considered. The cost is rent — the highest of any station currently on this site.
goodFor: People commuting to Shibuya or Roppongi
People who prioritise atmosphere and food quality
notFor: People who care about value for money
People who want a quiet residential street
People trying to fit a family-sized apartment into a budget
residentComment: The commute and the neighborhood are close to ideal; the entire weakness is the rent. The same budget buys you a noticeably larger apartment elsewhere. The question is simply whether this particular neighborhood is worth that to you.
